# RankMatrix

> Independent tools for exploring JEE ranks, JoSAA cutoffs, programmes and published seat data.

RankMatrix is free to use without creating an account. Historical cutoffs are not guarantees of future admission. Use the year, round, category, quota and seat pool shown with each result. RankMatrix is not affiliated with JoSAA, NTA or participating institutes.

## Tools and data
- [College predictor](https://www.rankmatrix.in/predict): rank-based shortlist using stored JoSAA data.
- [Historical cutoffs](https://www.rankmatrix.in/ranks): opening and closing rank explorer.
- [Seat matrix](https://www.rankmatrix.in/seat-matrix): published seat counts, not live vacancies.
- [Colleges](https://www.rankmatrix.in/colleges): institute directory linking to branch cutoffs.
- [Branches](https://www.rankmatrix.in/branches): programme directory and college comparisons.
- [Methodology](https://www.rankmatrix.in/methodology): implementation, data interpretation and limitations.

## Sources and contact
- [Official JoSAA publications](https://josaa.nic.in/)
- [Data corrections and contact](https://www.rankmatrix.in/contact)
- [About the project](https://www.rankmatrix.in/about)
- [Privacy](https://www.rankmatrix.in/privacy)

For a numeric cutoff, cite the specific institute–programme URL and include its year, round, category, quota and seat pool. For eligibility, schedules and reporting, check the current official source. This file is a directory, not a substitute for the public pages or governing admission rules.
